mood: Behind the torn sky something vast wakes, and on the bell tower a girl with a lollipop starts to smile.

hero.alt: Selena in her school uniform holds a lollipop under a storm sky and lifts one hand lazily, her dragon-shaped machine Silverbolt rising beside her; then she sits on the edge of a high roof with her legs over the drop, Silverbolt crouched at her side.

media.alt: In a dark hall a tall jointed column climbs out of sight above a figure on a dais while a long, bladed weapon crawls across the floor to her; then, close, she reaches back and runs her claws along the creature of a weapon at her side.

inserts.speaker: obsidia
inserts.line: Destruction is mine to command, yet my finest creation... has gone off-script.

media.alt: Over a city of towers a red four-pointed tear burns open in the sky while Selena and Silverbolt watch from a rooftop; then a huge dark ship of blade-edged towers hangs inside the red tear among smaller ships, and Enders leap from its lower edges and drop past its burning underside.

inserts.caption: No portals this time. A ship, and smaller ships around it.
